类 ManagementAssertion

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.sun.xml.internal.ws.policy.PolicyAssertion
      • com.sun.xml.internal.ws.policy.SimpleAssertion
        • com.sun.xml.internal.ws.api.config.management.policy.ManagementAssertion
  • 直接已知子类:
    ManagedClientAssertion, ManagedServiceAssertion

    public abstract class ManagementAssertion
extends SimpleAssertion
    Base class for the #ManagedClientAssertion and #ManagedServiceAssertion. Provides convenience methods to directly access the policy assertion parameters.
    作者:
    Fabian Ritzmann

    • 方法详细资料

      • getAssertion

        protected static <T extends ManagementAssertion> T getAssertion(QName name,
                                                                PolicyMap policyMap,
                                                                QName serviceName,
                                                                QName portName,
                                                                Class<T> type)
                                                         throws WebServiceException
        Return ManagementAssertion if one can be found in the policy map under the given service and port name.
        类型参数:
        T - The implementation class of the assertion.
        参数:
        name - The fully qualified name of the server or client assertion.
        policyMap - The policy map. May be null.
        serviceName - The WSDL service name. May not be null.
        portName - The WSDL port name. May not be null.
        type - The implementation class of the assertion.
        返回:
        An instance of ManagementAssertion or null.
        抛出:
        WebServiceException - If computing the effective policy of the endpoint scope failed.
